title: pane.read
description: Returns a pane's history and screen as plain text, with no escape sequences, newest last and with no line ends after the last text. At most 2,000,000 bytes: past that the oldest text goes, cut at a character. Needs hello version 2, and for now the pane must be the caller's own (the self scope). Reads of the caller's own pane are not redacted.

pane.description: The pane's number, which must be the caller's own.

lines.description: Only the last this many lines. Wrapped rows join into one line.
